# EzRTP

EzRTP is a modern rtp plugin for 1.21.x.
| Command | Permissions | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/rtp` | `ezrtp.use` | Opens the gui |
| `/rtp` | `ezrtp.world.overworld` | Overworld rtp permission |
| `/rtp` | `ezrtp.world.nether` | Nether rtp permission |
| `/rtp` | `ezrtp.world.the_end` | End rtp permission |
| `/rtp` | `ezrtp.bypass.cooldown` | 10 sec cooldown permission |

(every permission is on by default)
